title: Conditional κ = 0.00302666 (+4.31e-6 over #5377): eight joint helper relations
body:
This construction gives **conditional κ = 151333/50000000 = 0.00302666**, a gain of **0.00000431** over [PR #5377](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5377) and **0.0000048842** over the selected final [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610). Eight independent helper relations remove all eight backward rank-eight centers and eight later rank-one jobs, with all eight lost rank-nine helper targets charged.

The [proof and complete bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/README.md), [exact witness](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/WITNESS.json), [literal word](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/WORD.json.gz), [result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/RESULT.json) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4bd6efa51a495a7c7b7754915cf0244e7e60969e/research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023/SOURCES.json) define the review object. The branch starts at canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`. All runtime inputs are present at that base; the pending predecessor package is not a runtime dependency.

Each backward call retains 224 independent main fields and 400 independent helper fields. Exact row reduction prepares eight owned helper pivots. Eight simultaneous snapshots replace the centers in the same physical frames. Sixteen unrestricted source identities prove the COPY and zero replacements; a separate replay checks all 624 retained inputs and all 17 arbitrary owned entry fields. Forward calls and the p16 controller keep their source programs.

The complete controller removes 128 H1 and 128 H8 paid jobs, and 128 H9 productive targets, relative to the selected source. Its moment gain is `128(1 + 8^t - 9^t) > 0` for `0 < t < 1`. The bill has **64,148 paid jobs and 10,800 productive fields**, with rank surplus 752. Compared with the one-relation result, this removes 224 further paid jobs and 112 further helper targets. All preparation, COPY, CLEAR and eight new snapshot slots are charged: the local scalar allowance is 158,744, the route allowance is 4,834,000, and the complete raw nonrecursive bound is 181,098,496 < 10^9.

Two rational interval engines put the fixed-profile crossing in **(0.00302667476807, 0.00302667476808)**. The claimed bound leaves more than 1.476807e-8 raw headroom. The tested saving 0.00302667, reserve 1e-9, both completion tails, finite compiler and all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates pass. This ceiling applies to this complete profile, not all relation systems.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 or 3.14 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa-joint-relations-20261023
```

Both registered modes print:

```text
PASS_CONDITIONAL_KAPPA_00302666_EIGHT_JOINT_RELATIONS
```

Normal and optimized registered checks passed on CPython 3.12.14, and the direct author check passed on CPython 3.14. All seven native and five cost/outer rejection controls passed. Metadata/pins, 19 committed-file bindings, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free replays passed; all 20 exported files, including the manifest, remained unchanged. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI is separate and is not claimed here.

The full source phase lowering and ordinary BIT construction are authenticated and reused. This package does not rerun physical tape, numerical precision, analytic decomposition, prime avoidance or integer recovery. No expanded compiler word, Lean/Docker run, independent human acceptance or selected-frontier update is claimed. The result retains the five selected framework assumptions recorded in the [current admission review](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr4610/PROOF-REVIEW.md).

Credit: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. This extends our [frozen one-relation proof and verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c448d13c71908647f968b06cddb795ce7d288139/research/kappa-owned-relation-20261023/README.md). Cao Yifan supplied the [final native word and phase evidence](https://github.com/intqwq/integer-mult-bounds/blob/20bb93cd990d2ff683e4d0fc56b87a42cd5d3296/research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/ACTUAL-WORD.json.gz) in [PR #4610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610). Cinna Davis supplied the controller/helper lineage in [PR #4470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4470). Chris R supplied the independent source admission in [PR #5241](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5241); it does not admit this changed inventory. zxv supplied the cache contract and row/lifetime handoff in [PR #5283](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5283). The linked proof and pinned source notices retain Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Cinna Davis, ToikY and the earlier native/compiler/transfer credit.

The [canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154290) records the live overlap checks and the distinct neighboring scopes. This PR contains one new isolated research package and leaves the predecessor packages and selected record intact.
